title: Note Block Editor: InTone
description: Edit note blocks easily with the new dialogs.
body:
A datapack that improves note block editing using the dialogs feature.

## Features

### Tuning Fork 🔧
This item allows you to **easily edit** a note block by **right-clicking** on it. It **opens a dialog** where you can instantly **edit the note or instrument** of the note block.

The dialog is **intuitive and easy to use**. You have a **piano keyboard** and **buttons for each instrument** represented by the corresponding block.
